body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-014-v2-wallet-pantry-multistore.md (v2, builds on SC-001). Do not edit either spec. Do not call Gemini or any live API in tests. Do not commit secrets, personal data, or the e-bill PDFs. Money is integer LKR. A percent discount is (amount * rate_bps) // 10000.

Add ortools to pyproject.toml. Add src/savvycart/planner.py with plan_day(catalog, offers, lines, day, wallet, max_stores, trip_cost_lkr, usual_store) using CP-SAT with one worker and a fixed seed.
Rules: a store promotion lowers that line's price at that store first; promotions do not stack. A card offer applies to one store bill when its bank is in the wallet, store and day match, and the day is on or before valid_to. Eligible subtotal is the promoted price of lines whose category is included and not excluded. Card discount = min(floor(eligible * rate_bps / 10000), cap) when eligible >= minimum, else 0. At most one card offer per store bill. Each line goes to exactly one store that prices it; a line priced nowhere is unpriced and the plan incomplete. At most max_stores stores (1 or 2). Objective: promoted shelf total - card discounts + trip_cost_lkr * (stores used - 1). Equal-cost ties: fewer stores, then usual store, then store id.
Output per store: lines, chosen card or null, promotion savings, card discount, bill total. Plan totals, solver status OPTIMAL, baseline_usual (everything at the usual store, no offers, no promotions), baseline_single (best one-store plan), and savings against each. day_sweep(...) runs the next seven days and returns the cheapest day on or before the earliest next_due of the confirmed lines.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Split beats single store when the offer pays. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_planner.py::test_split_beats_single_store_when_offer_pays -q
2. Trip cost prevents tiny splits. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_planner.py::test_trip_cost_prevents_tiny_splits -q
3. Wallet gates offers, one card per bill. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_planner.py::test_wallet_gates_offers_and_one_card_per_bill -q
4. Minimum, cap, and expiry hold per bill. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_planner.py::test_minimum_cap_and_expiry_hold_per_bill -q
5. Promotion applies before the card offer. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_planner.py::test_promotion_applies_before_card_offer -q
6. Savings equal baseline minus plan. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_planner.py::test_savings_equal_baseline_minus_plan -q
7. Day sweep stays before run-out. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_planner.py::test_day_sweep_stays_before_run_out -q
8. Plans are deterministic with tie-breaks. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_planner.py::test_plans_are_deterministic_with_tie_breaks -q
title: Plan a shopping day across up to two stores with OR-Tools
